caption:
Lost and unsure which way to turn?

When the youths took refuge in the Cave, they asked their Lord for mercy from Himself and for the right way in their ordeal. Make their dua your own tonight.

Surah Al-Kahf 18:10

Send this to someone going through an ordeal right now

#dua #surahalkahf #peopleofthecave #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
